item.title: Planet Barnsley
item.description: Planet Barnsley is the first solo exhibition by Cara Proud, using immersive digital worlds to reimagine the town's identity, technology, and future possibilities. A survivor of the future clambered for spare parts to assemble their own independent computer. Technology in their world is designed to extract as much information, energy, and money as possible.
